name: io.github.tonyyang0504/mastodon-mcp
description: Mastodon (social): me, publish_text, read_comments, reply_comment, read_mentions, analytics_post, de

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MASTODON_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Mastodon user access token from the account's instance (Preferences > Development > New application, or an OAuth flow) with scopes read:accounts read:statuses read:notifications write:statuses; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MASTODON_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Host of the account's Mastodon instance without scheme, e.g. mastodon.social; every call goes to https://<instance>/api/v1/...
